comment: Demo 8's panels for grafana/releases.json: a catalog row with these two panels (ids and y to be set where the row goes), after the panels copied from the orders-service row with service="catalog".

panels.title: Ready pods per version, production
panels.description: Pods of catalog in production per version, ready and not ready, from kube-state-metrics through Grafana Alloy, every 15 seconds. During a release the new version's pods start next to the old ones; a version that never gets ready shows only as not ready until Helm rolls it back.

targets.expr: sum by (version) (label_replace(kube_pod_labels{namespace="production", label_app_kubernetes_io_name="catalog"}, "version", "$1", "label_app_kubernetes_io_version", "(.*)") * on (namespace, pod) group_left() kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="production", condition="true"})

sum by (version) (label_replace(kube_pod_labels{namespace="production", label_app_kubernetes_io_name="catalog"}, "version", "$1", "label_app_kubernetes_io_version", "(.*)") * on (namespace, pod) group_left() kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="production", condition="false"})

panels.description: Pods of catalog in staging per version, ready and not ready, from kube-state-metrics through Grafana Alloy, every 15 seconds. During a release the new version's pods start next to the old ones; a version that never gets ready shows only as not ready until Helm rolls it back.

targets.expr: sum by (version) (label_replace(kube_pod_labels{namespace="staging", label_app_kubernetes_io_name="catalog"}, "version", "$1", "label_app_kubernetes_io_version", "(.*)") * on (namespace, pod) group_left() kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="staging", condition="true"})

sum by (version) (label_replace(kube_pod_labels{namespace="staging", label_app_kubernetes_io_name="catalog"}, "version", "$1", "label_app_kubernetes_io_version", "(.*)") * on (namespace, pod) group_left() kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="staging", condition="false"})
